subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The firefighter summoned all her _________ (cowardice) and rushed into the burning building.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cowardice"** means lack of bravery or courage. (कायरता)

 
 
• **Example:** His cowardice in the face of danger was evident when he ran away instead of helping.
 
 
 
• **"Courage"** refers to the ability to do something that frightens one; bravery. (साहस)
 
 
• **Example:** She showed great courage by standing up to the bully.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'cowardice' is 'courage'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Erudition** (विद्वत्ता): The quality of having or showing great knowledge or learning.

 
 
• **Example:** His erudition was evident from the way he discussed complex topics.
 
 
 
• **Skills** (कौशल): The ability to do something well; expertise.
 
 
• **Example:** Her skills in painting are truly remarkable.
 
 
 
• **Expertise** (विशेषज्ञता): Expert skill or knowledge in a particular field.
 
 
• **Example:** His expertise in computer programming is unparalleled.
